Game Overview

Blast is a action title where blast into exhilarating action where precision and strategy are your best allies. Plant bombs with accuracy, avoiding perilous zones, to achieve high scores. Master your timing and aim through progressive challenges, all while enjoying easy controls in this fast-paced, high-stakes adventure. Patience and calculated moves are key!
